asked.item: Sequence for local mp4 with Codex and blotato_create_post

verdict.reason: The pages give the upload sequence for a local file with Codex and blotatocreatepost.

steps.text: Give the assistant access to the file you want to post.
Ask it to call blotatocreatepresigneduploadurl with the filename and extension.
Ask it to send the file bytes to presignedUrl with an HTTP PUT.
Check that the upload succeeded before using publicUrl.
Then ask it to use the returned publicUrl with blotatocreatepost.
